archived_validation_scope.confidence_scope: Pointwise component CP95 bounds, not simultaneous95% for all conditions, not anytime-valid, not an unselected fresh five-scenario study, not joint four-panel MC.
archived_validation_scope.note: A 2q union diagnostic above .05 does not prove inflation of the actual joint rule; it means these marginal bounds alone do not certify the desired joint bound. Pointwise CP95 bounds are not pooled or presented as a simultaneous95% statement.
archived_validation_scope.scope: Independent focal precision replication using unchanged frozen V4 method; a provenance composite carries four previously observed V4 scenarios with established bounds. Post-V4 selection is explicit, original inconclusive null retained, no pooling.

cells.reason: full declared temporal validation evidence bundle verified

confirmation_external_gates.reason: MSE/pooled-RMSE inference is not a test of inherited mean individual-seed RMSE. Preserve the explicit prospective amendment and resolve guide alignment before claiming R3.
Conditional one-panel error bounds do not alone certify the current two-of-three joint positive decision at .05. Do not silently tighten rules or alpha based on observed calibration outcomes.
Guide requires the own model in MCS or critical-difference evidence. Historical additive MCS and failed later MCS cannot be transferred. Between-panel assumptions also need justification.
A method-calibration ledger, seed minimum, T768 or B8191 do not establish market power or an independent reserve.

deterministic_composition_check.Holm180_role: Additional adverse EPA screen can remove positive decisions; it cannot enlarge the positive decision event or establish missing marginal super-uniformity.
deterministic_composition_check.alternative_bound: q for an intersection-union requirement of all panels/all rivals
deterministic_composition_check.caveat: Bounds require valid marginal family error assumptions for the actual DGP; finite pointwise simulation intervals do not establish that assumption for arbitrary markets or simultaneous confidence over scenarios.
deterministic_composition_check.current_rule_bound: max(q_main, max(q_i+q_j for two fixed null additional panels)); <=2q for uniform q

endpoint_non_equivalence.source_policy: The original protocol explicitly declares a prospective endpoint amendment, not academic acceptance or a rewrite of the historical pilot.
endpoint_non_equivalence.statement: sqrt is monotone in aggregate MSE, but average sqrt(seed MSE) is another functional. A favorable observed direction is not a hypothesis test for that other functional.
